contract.provides: P3 specifies a proposed abiotic peptoid relay in which intended aminolysis forms a product bond and changes its terminal carrier, while the origin remains support-bound. It exposes thiol-exchange bypasses that change the carrier without adding the intended residue, plus dimer insertions not removed by spent-arm destruction. Producer reports an internally audited favorable numerical window,1.436nmol correct delivered/code,93.68%raw correctness and71.80%yield, conditional on demanding unmeasured kinetics/preparation/clearing assumptions. The approximately47200USD/attempt organization loses to2400-3200USD ordinary cases. No physical relay, authenticated library, optical function, renewed register or advantage is established; earlier family results retain their scopes. Sar-initiated alpha-peptoid with20ordered additions, free N terminus and terminal carboxylic acid; DNA is a disposable recognition carrier rather than product backbone. Sixteen same-composition N2E6B6A6 programs have equal parent mass. Intended aminoacyl-thioester handover, hydrolytic dead acid, carrier-only exchange, recapture/duplicate additions, packet dimers/cycles, positional addresses, origin protection, carrier clearance and total initiated-product accounting are distinct operations.
